additional_schedule_inventory.classification: Six service/material rows: PCWS/R under 2-1/2 in copper; PCWS/R 3 in and larger 316L stainless; CHWS/R Schedule 40 black steel; compressed air copper; heating hot water copper; and makeup water copper. This is an installation schedule, not a device inventory.
Four testing rows: PCW, CHW, makeup water and compressed air; no BAS point count is inferred.
Two material rows: metal duct and fabric duct; this is not a damper-actuator schedule.
PCW riser utility schedule contains 29 literal branch/device lines and a printed total flow of 65.45 GPM. Existing/new identifiers and grouped branch sums are retained in equipment reconciliation.

NEH PCW Flow Demand separates existing and new columns. Printed existing PCW flow is 536.9 GPM, new PCW flow is 581.998 GPM, future factor increase is 10%, resulting new PCW flow requirement is 640.20 GPM, and pump selection flow is 650 GPM.
One new B950A-PF-1001 pot feeder: JL Wingert Co 5HD; B950A mechanical room; 5.79 gal; 200 PSIG; 200°F; 21-1/8 in H x 10 in diameter; dry 33 lb/wetted 81.37 lb.
One new B950A-ET-1001 expansion tank: Wessels NLA-85, part 22010085; 23 gal; 125 PSIG; 240°F; 37 in H x 16 in diameter; dry 90 lb/wetted 281.82 lb.
One new B950A-WF-1001 water filter: Shellco SJCH-170 filter housing, four Shellco SJC-170-20 filter cartridges, 150 GPM per cartridge/600 GPM total, 20 micron.

control_valve_schedule.note: The M6.3 P&ID shows an AO TCV MODULATION callout, but the set has no tabular control-valve schedule with tag, Cv, actuator, signal or fail position.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: M7.0 mentions motorized dampers in an existing-AHU note but prints no damper tag list, actuator torque/model, control signal or fail position.
